patterns.pattern: When is your birthday? - It is in + [month].
patterns.vi: Sinh nhật của bạn là khi nào? - Vào tháng [tháng].
examples: When is your birthday? - It is in May.
When is your birthday? - It is in October.
When is your birthday? - It is in December.

patterns.pattern: When is your birthday? - It is on the + [date] + of + [month].
patterns.vi: Sinh nhật của bạn vào ngày nào? - Vào ngày [ngày] tháng [tháng].
examples: When is your birthday? - It is on the fifth of March.
When is your birthday? - It is on the twentieth of November.
When is your birthday? - It is on the first of January.

patterns.pattern: What will you do on your birthday? - I will + [verb].
patterns.vi: Bạn sẽ làm gì vào ngày sinh nhật? - Tớ sẽ [hành động].
examples: What will you do on your birthday? - I will invite my friends.
What will you do on your birthday? - I will blow out the candles.
What will you do on your birthday? - I will eat a big cake.

patterns.pattern: Were you happy on your birthday? - Yes, I was. / No, I was not.
patterns.vi: Bạn có vui vào sinh nhật không? - Có, tớ rất vui. / Không, tớ không.
examples: Were you happy on your birthday? - Yes, I was.
Were you excited about your birthday? - Yes, I was very excited.
Were you sad at the party? - No, I was not.

patterns.pattern: Who came to your party? - [Name/People] came to my party.
patterns.vi: Ai đã đến dự tiệc của bạn? - [Tên/Người] đã đến dự tiệc của tớ.
examples: Who came to your party? - My classmates came to my party.
Who came to your party? - Nam and Mai came to my party.
Who came to your party? - My grandparents came to my party.

patterns.pattern: My birthday is bigger/louder than yours!
patterns.vi: Sinh nhật của tớ lớn hơn/nhộn nhịp hơn của bạn!
examples: My cake is bigger than your cake.

patterns.pattern: What gift do you want? - I want a/an + [noun].
patterns.vi: Bạn muốn món quà gì? - Tớ muốn một [món đồ].

grammar.title: Prepositions of Time: IN vs. ON
grammar.explain_en: Use 'in' for months, years, and seasons. Use 'on' for specific dates and special days.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'in' đi với tháng, năm, mùa. Dùng 'on' đi với ngày cụ thể hoặc dịp lễ.
examples: My birthday is in July.
My party is on July 12th.
We celebrate Teacher's Day on November 20th.

grammar.title: Past Simple of 'be': WAS and WERE
grammar.explain_en: Use 'was' with I, he, she, it, and singular nouns. Use 'were' with you, we, they, and plural nouns.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'was' cho I, he, she, it và danh từ số ít. Dùng 'were' cho you, we, they và danh từ số nhiều.
examples: I was happy yesterday.
The candles were on the cake.
My friends were at my house last night.
grammar.right: ✅ My friends were happy at the party.
grammar.wrong: ❌ My friends was happy at the party.

grammar.title: Future Intentions with WILL
grammar.explain_en: Use 'will' + base verb to express a promise, plan, or decision for the future.
grammar.explain_vi: Dùng 'will' + động từ nguyên thể để thể hiện ý định hoặc kế hoạch trong tương lai.
examples: I will make invitations tomorrow.
We will sing a birthday song.
He will wear a blue party hat.
grammar.right: ✅ I will buy five red balloons.
grammar.wrong: ❌ I will buying five red balloons.

grammar.title: Ordinal Numbers for Dates
grammar.explain_en: When saying dates, use ordinal numbers like 1st (first), 2nd (second), 3rd (third), 4th (fourth).
grammar.explain_vi: Khi nói ngày tháng, dùng số thứ tự như 1st (first), 2nd (second), 3rd (third), 4th (fourth).
examples: My birthday is on the first of May.
Today is the second of October.
Her party is on the twentieth of June.
grammar.right: ✅ It is on the third of March.
grammar.wrong: ❌ It is on the three of March.

readings.title: Four Seasons of Birthdays
readings.text: In our class, pupils have birthdays in all four seasons. There are twelve months in a year. Nam was born in January, so his birthday is in winter. He loves cold weather because his family makes hot soup. An has her birthday in April. Spring is warm and flowers are everywhere. My birthday is in July, in the middle of summer holiday. I usually celebrate it at the beach with my cousins. We make sandcastles and play games. Hoa's birthday is in October. Autumn leaves are orange and yellow. She invites all of us to her garden. Every month brings different joy. We love celebrating birthdays together!

readings.title: A Surprise Birthday Party for Ben
readings.text:
Last week, our class planned a special secret for Ben. Ben was born on the twentieth of November. He thought nobody remembered his birthday! In the morning, Ben walked into the classroom. It was dark and quiet. Suddenly, the lights turned on! Everyone shouted, 'Happy Birthday, Ben!' Ben was so surprised that his eyes opened wide.

Our teacher, Ms. Anna, placed a large strawberry cake on the teacher's desk. There were nine pink candles on top. Ben blew out all the candles in one big breath. Then, Tom gave Ben a colorful card. All of us wrote friendly messages inside it. Linh brought floating balloons, and Nam played a happy song on his recorder.

Ben said, 'Thank you, everyone! This is the best birthday party ever!' We shared cake, played musical chairs, and laughed together. Ben will remember this happy day for a very long time.

life_skill.title: BE GRATEFUL AND KIND ON YOUR BIRTHDAY
life_skill.intro: A birthday is not just about gifts and cake. It is a special time to thank your parents and share joy with others!
life_skill.intro_vi: Sinh nhật không chỉ là quà và bánh. Đó là dịp đặc biệt để cảm ơn cha mẹ và chia sẻ niềm vui với mọi người xung quanh!

Include all classmates when playing party games.
Be happy even if I do not get every present I want.

classroom_game.name: Birthday Month Line-Up
steps_en: Step 1: Students stand up and walk around the classroom silently.
Step 2: When the teacher says 'Find your month!', students ask each other 'When is your birthday?'.
Step 3: Students form 12 groups according to their birthday months (January to December).
Step 4: Each month group shouts their month and sings one line of 'Happy Birthday'.
Step 5: The fastest month group to stand in date order wins the round!
steps_vi: Bước 1: Học sinh đứng dậy và đi lại nhẹ nhàng quanh lớp.
Bước 2: Khi thầy cô hô 'Find your month!', học sinh hỏi nhau 'When is your birthday?'.
Bước 3: Học sinh xếp thành 12 nhóm tương ứng với 12 tháng sinh.
Bước 4: Mỗi nhóm tháng hô to tên tháng của mình và hát một câu 'Happy Birthday'.
Bước 5: Nhóm tháng nào xếp hàng đúng thứ tự ngày sinh nhanh nhất sẽ chiến thắng!
